large-map-ubuntu-24.04-arm.scope: Maintained map benchmark: build 500,000 sorted key/value pairs and perform 2,000,000 lookups. C/Rust outputs agree with every fwp variant. Same runner, compiler and fwp source; compare numeric construction fusion on/off in both default tracing and checked ARC. Separate construction-only fwp programs print the map size; their timings are not a direct measurement of lookup time and must not be subtracted as one. Whole-process time includes startup, allocation, construction, queries/output and shutdown. Build time includes fwp C generation, native compilation/linking and any ordinary compiler cache effects. C/Rust sorting and overflow rules differ; the guide explains these comparisons. Counter instrumentation uses separate executables excluded from timing. Counted storage excludes allocator capacity and process RSS; tracing may retain uncollected storage. Every variant occupies every position twice after warmup. Actual timed executables, sources, hashes, raw samples and disassembly are saved. No universal speed threshold or cross-run regression conclusion is assumed.
